title: Open Promise Ledger v0.1: promise
description: One public promise by a government actor about AI or a closely related digital rule, with the source it rests on and what happened to it. The outcome is never stored: it is computed from claim_type, deadline and outcome_date. See README.md in this folder.

date_said.description: The day the promise was made, in the speaker's time zone.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the government that made the promise.

who.description: The speaker as the source names them, then a comma and their body or title, for example "Meutya Hafid, Minister".

role_en.description: Optional. The speaker's role at the time, as the source states it, in English.

role_id.description: Optional. The same role in the ledger's second language.

instrument.description: Optional. The id of the instrument the promise is about, only when the source names it.

claim_type.description: dated: has a deadline that can pass. conditional: depends on an event and has no date. status_claim: a claim about progress with no deadline.

deadline_rule.description: How the deadline follows from the wording: "within N months", "within N days", "end YYYY-MM", "end YYYY-Qn", "end YYYY-Hn", "end YYYY" or "on YYYY-MM-DD". Dated promises only.

deadline.description: The last day the promise could still be kept. Dated promises only.

deadline_basis_en.description: The wording in the source that sets the deadline, or explains why there is none, and how the date was derived.

deadline_basis_id.description: The same explanation in the language the promise was made in (see README.md on field names).

promised_en.description: The promise in one line, in English.

promised_id.description: The promise in one line, in the language it was made in.

outcome_en.description: What has happened since, in one line. Narrative only: it never sets the computed outcome.

outcome_id.description: The same line in the ledger's second language.

outcome_date.description: Optional. The day the promise was kept or the outcome was confirmed.

outcome_source_url.description: Required with outcome_date: the source that shows it.

evidence.description: legal-text, official-statement or press-report, as defined in README.md.

source_url.description: The report or record of the promise.

archive_url.description: A preserved copy of source_url, for example in the Internet Archive.

archived_at.description: The day that copy was made.
